name: My Network
author: Omarchy
description: Network management with active subnet warnings, resilient temporary IPv4 recovery, portable saved setup shortcuts, reliable backups, usage totals, and Proton VPN status

barWidget.description: Wi-Fi and Ethernet management, safer temporary device setup, portable saved shortcuts, profile backups, usage totals, and Proton VPN controls

schema.label: Proton VPN country (optional)
schema.description: Optional country code or name for connect (e.g. US, NL). Leave empty for the fastest free server.

schema.label: Confirm before forgetting a network
schema.description: Ask before removing a saved profile. Forgetting deletes its stored password, which cannot be recovered without re-entering it.

schema.label: Scan for Wi-Fi when the panel opens
schema.description: Restart the radio scan on every open. Turn off to save battery and just read the cached list.

schema.label: Show the saved networks section
schema.description: List stored Wi-Fi profiles separately from the scan, so a network out of range can still be managed, reordered and removed.

schema.label: Show the Ethernet section
schema.description: Link speed, duplex, MAC, MTU, driver, error counters, and stored wired profiles.

schema.label: Show the network details section
schema.description: Resolved DNS servers, IPv6 address, public address, firewall posture, and Tailscale state.

schema.label: Show throughput history
schema.description: Draw throughput and latency history under the connection details.

schema.label: Look up the public address
schema.description: Query a third-party service for this machine's public IP address. Turn off to keep the panel from contacting the internet on its own.
